desc: credential persistence through GitHub Actions artifacts

comments: # API-only Playwright suite: request fixture, no browser launched, so it
# runs before the Chromium download and isolates API failures.
# Separate step so browser failures never conflate with API failures.
concrete.feature:
lab:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      COREPACK_ENABLE_DOWNLOAD_PROMPT: '0'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 24

      - name: Enable pinned pnpm
        run: |
          corepack enable
          pnpm --version

      - name: Install (frozen lockfile)
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Lint
        run: pnpm lint

      - name: Unit tests (Vitest, real PGlite)
        run: pnpm test

      - name: Audit ground truth (pnpm audit --prod vs snapshot)
        run: pnpm audit:check

      - name: Scenario integrity (route sources vs hash manifest)
        run: pnpm scenario:check

      - name: Build main lab app
        run: pnpm build

      - name: Build React2Shell fixture
        run: pnpm build:react2shell

      - name: Start main lab app
        run: |
          pnpm start &
          for i in $(seq 1 60); do
            curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:3000/ >/dev/null && echo "main app up" && exit 0
            sleep 1
          done
          echo "main app failed to start" && exit 1

      # API-only Playwright suite: request fixture, no browser launched, so it
      # runs before the Chromium download and isolates API failures.
      - name: API tests (Playwright, no browser)
        run: pnpm test:api

      - name: Install Chromium for browser tests
        run: pnpm exec playwright install --with-deps chromium

      # Separate step so browser failures never conflate with API failures.
      - name: Browser execution tests (Playwright)
        run: pnpm test:browser

      - name: Start React2Shell fixture
        run: |
          pnpm start:react2shell &
          for i in $(seq 1 60); do
            curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:3001/ >/dev/null && echo "fixture up" && exit 0
            sleep 1
          done
          echo "fixture failed to start" && exit 1

      - name: React2Shell runtime probe
        run: pnpm test:react2shell

      - name: Raw audit visibility (expected findings, never blocking)
        run: pnpm audit:lab || echo "::notice::pnpm audit reports the intentional vulnerable pins (see docs/vulnerabilities/react2shell.md)"
